demand.validation_design: Last 18 months held out; no future rows used in training.

returns.validation_design: Hold out entire final 20% of cohorts; person-period rows never cross split.

recovery.validation_design: Final 20% synthetic return records held out before training.

ai_to_or_bridge.evidence_class: PREDICTED SYNTHETIC STATE -> STOCHASTIC OR INPUT CONTRACT

tradeoffs: Modeled cost, carbon, virgin-material dependence and tail-risk are competing objectives.
Second-life allocation withholds material from current-horizon recycling/remanufacturing feed.
N-1 reserve capacity increases fixed cost when selected but protects recovery capacity against a single-site loss.
assumptions: All numerical scenario results are synthetic/offline validation evidence.
Phase-2 model evidence is based on synthetic held-out data, not field observations.
Lifecycle impact factors remain externally uncalibrated.
Emergency recovery in policy replay represents an expensive external processor used only when fixed installed capacity is insufficient.
decision.evidence_class: EXPLAINABLE RECOMMENDATION FROM VALIDATED SYNTHETIC COMPUTATIONAL CHAIN
